query:
SELECT mc.id, mc.name, mc.cardNumber, mc.cardType, mc.imageUrl, cs.name as setName 
FROM marvel_cards mc 
JOIN card_sets cs ON mc.setId = cs.id 
WHERE cs.slug = '2025-topps-marvel-sapphire' 
AND mc.imageUrl IS NOT NULL 
AND mc.imageUrl NOT LIKE '%marvel-ai-%' 
AND mc.imageUrl NOT LIKE '%CBH-%' 
AND mc.imageUrl NOT LIKE '%placeholder%'
AND mc.imageUrl NOT LIKE '%hulk-comic%'
ORDER BY mc.cardNumber
